name: cta-contact-morph
title: CTA Contact Morph
description: A contact call-to-action whose button springs open into a fill-in-the-sentence message, then folds back into a sent confirmation. The block keeps the open size, so nothing on the page moves.
docs:
Docs, props and examples: https://tween-ui.vercel.app/block/cta-contact-morph
Pass `onSend` to deliver the message (it receives `name`, `email`, `topic` and `details`); throw from it to show the retry message. Without it the block only simulates a send.
